statement: Permanent KV eviction is unsafe in multi-turn dialogue because token importance shifts across turns, and the fix (retaining full history) sacrifices the storage saving that motivated eviction. RocketKV shows a noticeable accuracy gap to Exact-TopK on SCBench multi-turn at high budgets because tokens evicted in earlier turns become essential later; RocketKV-MT retains all KV tokens across turns (no storage saving) but filters per turn for decode speed, matching Exact-TopK. This is a direct tension within the eviction route: the memory saving and the multi-turn robustness are mutually exclusive under permanent eviction, motivating either non-permanent selection (dynamic top-k) or hierarchical storage (keep history in cheaper tiers).
